detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with search access to `index=alibaba`.
• Install and configure Splunk Add-on for Alibaba Cloud with the modular input for `alibaba:actiontrail`.
• Prerequisite crawl UC(s): UC-4.8.1.
• Confirm field extractions in `props.conf` for `eventName` and related actor fields.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Configure required cloud inputs per provider guide; index=alibaba sourcetype=alibaba:actiontrail.
Validate ingest before alerting:
```spl
index=alibaba sourcetype="alibaba:actiontrail" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=alibaba sourcetype="alibaba:actiontrail" eventName="DeleteBucket"
| table _time eventName userIdentity.userName resourceName
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.8.15_alibaba_actiontrail_dele_15"
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
Scopes `alibaba:actiontrail` in `index=alibaba` to detect alibaba actiontrail deletebucket. Tune thresholds to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals and sandbox accounts via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare to the Alibaba Cloud ActionTrail console for the same 24-hour window. Confirm row counts and `eventName` values match the vendor console. Run `| fieldsummary` on a 1-hour sample to verify extractions.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_8_15_alert` with severity aligned to `high` criticality. Dashboard: Dashboard panel, alert, and weekly compliance report..
Failure modes: (1) no events — verify modular input/API credentials and index routing; (2) empty actor fields — upgrade Splunk Add-on for Alibaba Cloud and review alias mappings; (3) API throttling — reduce poll frequency or enable queue buffering; (4) alert fatigue — tune thresholds and document exclusions in knownFalsePositives.
